title: pouteria ambelaniifolia
intro: Pouteria ambelaniifolia, commonly known as the white guava, is a plant species native to Central and South America. The white guava is a shrub or small tree that provides various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce symptoms of fever, pain, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria ambelaniifolia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
